# Resume & JD Parsing

## Objective

Extract structured skills from resumes and job descriptions.

## Inputs

- Resume Text
- Job Description Text

## Outputs

- parsed_resume.csv
- parsed_job.csv

## Features

- Skill Extraction
- Structured Parsing
- Skill Matching
- Parser Demonstration

## Generated Files

outputs/parsed_resume.csv

outputs/parsed_job.csv
